patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact photography dominates content sections, creating a gallery-like vertical scroll experience.
An elegant, large italic serif font is used for primary descriptive text, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for navigation and metadata.
A sophisticated, muted palette features deep darks, a warm light beige, and the rich, varied tones inherent in the artistic photography.
The initial hero image scrolls up to reveal a new, light-background section where a persistent header-like text block appears at the top, and a large descriptive text block fades into view.
Each photograph functions as a distinct, full-screen content block, creating a curated, immersive visual experience as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed hero image with text overlay that scrolls out of view. As it recedes, a new, light-background section is revealed, featuring a top-aligned text element that appears to stick or remain visible, and a large, centered text block that animates into view with a subtle fade or slide effect. Subsequent content is presented as a series of full-bleed, high-resolution photographs, creating a visually immersive scrolling gallery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant italic serif (~3x body) for descriptive text, with small uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed image sections and ample padding around text blocks, emphasizing individual elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, art-focused photography as the primary content structure, combined with a dramatic scroll-triggered transition from an immersive hero to an editorial introduction, sets it apart. It prioritizes visual impact and a curated gallery experience over typical marketing layouts.
